name: Standard Single Vision
description: Ideal for correcting nearsightedness or farsightedness. Clear vision at one distance.

name: Progressive (No-Line Bifocals)
description: Seamless transition between distance, intermediate, and near vision without visible lines.

name: Blue Light Filtering
description: Reduces eye strain from digital screens by filtering out harmful blue light.

name: Transitions® (Photochromic)
description: Lenses that automatically darken in sunlight and lighten indoors.

name: High-Index (Thinner & Lighter)
description: Recommended for strong prescriptions to make lenses noticeably thinner and lighter.

name: Polarized Sunglasses
description: Reduces glare from reflective surfaces like water and roads for clearer, more comfortable vision.
